_comment: Single source of truth for the Broadway Fantasy League season. Read by src/config/fantasy.ts (site + API) AND scripts/generate-fantasy-config.js / compute-fantasy-scores.js (weekly pipeline). tests/unit/broadway-fantasy-league.test.mjs asserts data/fantasy-league.json was generated from these values and that tonyWindow matches src/lib/tony-cutoffs.ts.
datesNote: Relaunch 2026-10-16 (BRO-5424): promotion starts with the draft on Fri Oct 30; players get four weeks to pick, closing Sun Nov 29 at 11:59pm ET (EST, so 04:59:59Z). Box office counts for everyone from Mon Nov 30, so nobody drafts with known grosses. earlyBirdCutoff equal to the deadline date means there is no late entry; set the deadline later than the cutoff to reopen late drafting (late entries then score box office from the day they draft).
scoringEndNote: PROVISIONAL: the 80th Tony Awards ceremony date has not been announced (Sept 2026). Update when it is, and add the 80th ceremony to data/tony-ceremony-dates.json; the unit test pins the two together.
